description: A construction company in the tropics uses cows and elephants to carry bricks. A cow can carry 20 bricks on its back while an elephant can carry 50 bricks on its back. To avoid having elephants create too much traffic, the number of elephant cannot exceed the number of cows. In addition, there can be at most twice the number of cows as elephants. If the company needs to transport at least 1000 bricks, find the minimum number of animals, cows and elephants, that can be used..

BrickCapacityCow.definition: Number of bricks a cow can carry on its back

BrickCapacityElephant.definition: Number of bricks an elephant can carry on its back

MaxElephantsToCowsRatio.definition: Maximum ratio of elephants to cows

MaxCowsToElephantsRatio.definition: Maximum ratio of cows to elephants

RequiredBricks.definition: Minimum number of bricks to transport

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of animals (cows and elephants) used to transport at least the required number of bricks"

constraints.description: The number of elephants must be less than or equal to the number of cows, and the number of cows must be less than or equal to twice the number of elephants
The total number of bricks transported by cows and elephants must be at least the required number of bricks
The number of cows and the number of elephants must be integers

numCows.definition: Number of cows used to transport bricks

numElephants.definition: Number of elephants used to transport bricks
